$comment: X6 deprecation registry (docs/proposals/relay-grand-plan.md SX6). One entry per deprecated surface. This JSON is the single source of truth read by BOTH the Worker middleware (src/deprecations.ts) and the CI pre-sunset gate (scripts/check-sunsets.mjs). Dates are UTC ISO days. To extend a sunset, change sunsetAt in a commit; to sunset a surface, set tombstoned=true in the same commit the gate would otherwise fail - the old paths then answer a structured 410. Removal of a surface additionally requires the zero-identities-in-30-days sightings query to return 0 (surfaceRemovalAllowed in src/deprecations.ts).

deprecations.note: Bare /auth/* moved under /v1/. Pure alias: same handlers, byte-identical bodies.
